title: Add Zoomable Compose Diagram
description: Make the compose/ui Diagram component zoomable while preserving the current minimal mini-map rendering, diff coloring, selection, and click callbacks. Add local viewport behavior suitable for a small diagram preview and verify compose/ui type-check and Storybook build after the change.
summary: Added cursor-centered wheel zoom and double-click reset to the compose/ui Diagram component while preserving the existing minimal rendering, diff coloring, selection, and click callbacks. Re-verified compose/ui type-check and Storybook build.
